companies.name: GE Aerospace
companies.description: Designs, manufactures and services commercial and military aircraft engines, components and systems; standalone public company since GE's 2024 separation. Its Colibrium Additive business (formerly GE Additive) supplies metal AM machines and expertise.
companies.presence: Global; major U.S. engineering and manufacturing sites in Ohio, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Indiana and others
products: Commercial turbofans (CFM LEAP via CFM International, GE9X, GEnx)

propulsion_turbomachinery: commercial and military jet-engine design and hot-section hardware
additive_manufacturing: production additive parts in its engines and its Colibrium Additive business
lpbf: laser powder bed fusion machines and process development (Colibrium Additive)
superalloys_high_temp: nickel-based superalloys and hot-section materials for turbine engines
am_qualification_standards: qualifying additive parts for certified flight engines
heat_treatment_hip: post-processing and heat treatment of engine-grade alloys
mechanical_testing: materials and component testing that supports engine certification
ndt_metrology: inspection of critical rotating engine parts
manufacturing_engineering: global engine manufacturing and assembly operations
process_optimization: lean operating model (FLIGHT DECK) across its plants
simulation_fea: structural and thermal analysis of engine hardware
research_development: GE Aerospace Research center in Niskayuna, NY

technical_challenges: Qualifying AM hot-section parts across machines and lots
Raising temperature capability of hot-section materials
Scaling production rates for LEAP and military programs
companies.eligibility_notes: Mix of commercial and defense work. Defense and export-controlled roles may require U.S. person status; commercial roles vary by posting.

participation.evidence: GE Aerospace's careers site has an event page titled 'GE Aerospace at SHPE National Convention & Career Fair 2026' in Indianapolis, Indiana.

companies.name: Honeywell Aerospace
companies.description: Honeywell's aerospace business supplies propulsion (auxiliary power units, turbofan and turboshaft engines), avionics, flight controls, and mechanical and electrical systems for commercial, defense and space customers.
companies.presence: Global; large U.S. engineering sites in Arizona, Minnesota, Florida, New Mexico and others

aerospace_systems: avionics, flight controls and aircraft mechanical systems
superalloys_high_temp: hot-section materials for turbines and APUs

technical_challenges: Weight and efficiency improvements in propulsion and power systems
companies.eligibility_notes: Several Summer 2027 engineering internships are labelled 'U.S. Person Required' and state that sponsorship is not available (see Job Tracker). Check each posting.

participation.evidence: Listed as a Gold sponsor on the official 2026 SHPE National Convention registration site; TechPoint also names Honeywell Aerospace among major participants.
Appears in a search-index capture of SHPE's 2026-2027 Industry Partnership Council page.
